avoid_for: Data-dense dashboards, formal enterprise or luxury brand decks, text-heavy long-form editorial, or anything needing cool-tone restraint — the 189px type and single-orange palette overwhelm quiet or informational contexts.
best_for: Crypto / web3 / protocol ecosystem landing pages and feature announcements that want volcanic urgency with warm credibility — ultrabold condensed type, flat warm surfaces, and one dominant orange, Berachain/Monad territory.
name: Caldera
palette_voice: Warm limestone canvas: Pumice (#e2e2df) page ground, Limestone (#f7f6f2) cards, Obsidian (#070607) near-black text, with a single aggressive chromatic accent Ember (#fc5000) carrying CTAs and stat cards; Plasma Violet (#524ae9) is reserved for the hero halftone and one accent card, Sulfur (#f5f28e) only for tags — Chalk white for dark sections; three chromatic tones max, deliberately shadowless, hierarchy via warm-gray tonal contrast, never elevation.
signature_moves: Triple-radius system — 100px inputs / 40px cards & rectangular buttons / 800px full pills — the consistent roundness that defines every control
189px ultrabold compressed display headline at 0.94 line-height — sign-painted, near-architectural scale as the page signature
Hero halftone dot pattern — orange dots on a violet-to-orange gradient, always at hero scale with 40px radius, the most recognizable motif
Filled Ember (#fc5000) pill CTA with Obsidian text, never rectangular — the sole aggressive chromatic action
Dotted 1.5px Obsidian dividers (not dashed, not solid) as a small consistent signature detail in nav and partner strips

source.shadow: none — deliberately shadowless, hierarchy via warm-gray contrast and 40px radii

tagline: forge fire on warm limestone. The canvas is raw warm plaster, and every orange element reads as glowing embers pressed into the surface.
typographic_voice: Ultrabold condensed display (PP Neue Corp Compact, subst. Bebas Neue/Anton) at 80-189px with positive +0.02em tracking carries all structural weight, while DM Sans at weight 500 only handles body, nav, and labels (never Regular, never Bold); system sans at 12px for captions; the 189px architectural display with tight 0.94 leading is the signature — no negative tracking, no thin or decorative faces.
